title: Compass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- compass body: outer brass ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='38' fill='#c8a24a'/>
  <!-- inner rim lighter shade -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#e8c96a'/>
  <!-- face of compass: white dial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='30' fill='#f4f0e6'/>
  <!-- dial shading ring for edge separation -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='#e0d8c8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='#fffdf4'/>
  <!-- cardinal tick marks -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='24' width='3' height='6' rx='1' fill='#8b6a2a'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='74' width='3' height='6' rx='1' fill='#8b6a2a'/>
  <rect x='22' y='50.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8b6a2a'/>
  <rect x='72' y='50.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8b6a2a'/>
  <!-- red needle pointing up-right -->
  <polygon points='50,52 57,30 50,36' fill='#e0402a'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 43,30 50,36' fill='#ff8a6a'/>
  <!-- blue needle pointing down-left -->
  <polygon points='50,52 43,74 50,68' fill='#2a4ec8'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 57,74 50,68' fill='#6a8aff'/>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='5' fill='#c8a24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='3' fill='#f0dca0'/>
  <!-- smiling face: two eyes on dial -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='3.2' fill='#7a5a1a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='3.2' fill='#7a5a1a'/>
  <!-- eyes shine -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='51' r='1' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='51' r='1' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M43 60 Q50 68 57 60' stroke='#7a5a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blushes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little top loop / ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#c8a24a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2' fill='#e8c96a'/>
</svg>
